title: Cage
body:
Spawner Fragments are an important resource in Disorder of the Stone, and spawners are non-renewable. So how are players supposed to get more when, say, everyone on a server has already broken every spawner within a couple of thousand blocks?

To solve this, a non-regular hostile mob, the **Cage**, is being added. It spawns very rarely and acts as a sort of mobile spawner, dropping a Spawner Fragment when it dies.
